knowledge_point.title: Determining the Dimension of the Product of Two Matrices Given the Dimensions of the Factors

question.:question/problem: Suppose $A$ is a $5 \times 3$ matrix and $B$ is a $3 \times 5$ matrix. What are the dimensions of $AB$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
There are $3$ columns in $A$ and $3$ rows in $B.$ Since the number of columns in $A$ equals the number of rows in $B,$ the matrices $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication, and $AB$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix:

$$
{A}_{5\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\times }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 5}={AB}_{5\times 5}
$$
